## https://micahboswell.design/

micahboswell.design

 Micah Boswell

 Product design leader. Thirty years of enterprise software. Dallas, Texas. Raised in Lima, Peru.

 In one paragraph

 Micah Boswell is a product design leader in Dallas, Texas. He has spent thirty years shipping enterprise software for AT&T, Citi, GE, Dell, the U.S. Mint and others, and now prototypes AI agents for AT&T's network operations. He mentors designers, writes about design and faith, photographs Dallas at night for Unsplash, where his work has 53 million views and 362,000 downloads and sits in the top 10 percent of contributors, and grew up in Lima, Peru.

 The working portfolio, case studies and essays live at conscious-shell.com, online since 2000. This page is the short version, kept current so that the record about him is his.

 Now

 As of October 2026
 Lead Product Designer at AT&T since 2021, working on the tools that run on-premise and cloud network infrastructure. He led design of NetBond Advanced, now live; its coded prototype was engineering's visual reference for what to build and saved months of iteration. He framed an agentic model for network operations, AI agents across the lifecycle from provisioning through decommissioning, prototyped its NetBond agent, led AT&T's enterprise AI design pilot, and redesigned the DNI Portal diagnostics, which cut hardware spend by more than $300,000.

 Recognized with the AT&T Connection Award four years running, 2023 through 2026: Deep Network Integration Leadership, Setting User Experience Vision, NetBond Advanced Leadership, and AI Design Leadership.

 Frequently asked

 Who is Micah Boswell?

 Micah Boswell is a product design leader in Dallas, Texas, with thirty years in enterprise software. He is Lead Product Designer at AT&T, where he prototypes AI agents for network operations. He also writes, mentors designers, and photographs the city.

 What does Micah Boswell do at AT&T?

 He leads product design for network infrastructure tools. He led design of NetBond Advanced, now live, through a coded prototype that engineering used as its visual reference. He framed an agentic model for network operations, AI agents across the lifecycle from provisioning to decommissioning, prototyped its NetBond agent, led the company's enterprise AI design pilot, and redesigned the DNI Portal diagnostics, which saved more than $300,000 in hardware.

 Where is Micah Boswell from?

 He grew up in Lima, Peru, and speaks Spanish and English. He studied at Hardin-Simmons University in Abilene, Texas, and has worked in Dallas since the late 1990s.

 What has Micah Boswell written?

 Essays on design and AI at conscious-shell.com and on LinkedIn, and more than a hundred answers on Quora.

 Is this the same Micah Boswell as the one I found somewhere else?

 Several people share the name. This page is about the Dallas product designer who works at AT&T. His profiles are listed under Elsewhere on this page. A profile that is not on that list belongs to someone else.

 How do I contact Micah Boswell?

 Through the contact form at conscious-shell.com, or by message on LinkedIn.


## https://micahboswell.design/es

micahboswell.design · en español

 Micah Boswell

 Líder de diseño de producto. Treinta años de software empresarial. Dallas, Texas. Criado en Lima, Perú.

 En un párrafo

 Micah Boswell es líder de diseño de producto en Dallas, Texas. Lleva treinta años creando software empresarial para AT&T, Citi, GE, Dell, la Casa de Moneda de Estados Unidos y otros, y hoy prototipa agentes de inteligencia artificial para las operaciones de red de AT&T. Es mentor de diseñadores, escribe sobre diseño y fe, fotografía Dallas de noche para Unsplash, donde su obra suma 53 millones de vistas y 362.000 descargas y está entre el 10 por ciento de colaboradores más vistos y creció en Lima, Perú.

 El portafolio, los casos de estudio y los ensayos están en conscious-shell.com, en línea desde el año 2000. Esta es la versión corta, en español, para la parte de su vida que empezó en el Perú. La versión en inglés es la página principal.

 Ahora

 Octubre de 2026
 Lead Product Designer en AT&T desde 2021, en las herramientas que operan la infraestructura de red local y en la nube. Lideró el diseño de NetBond Advanced, ya disponible; su prototipo en código fue la referencia visual de ingeniería para lo que debía construir y ahorró meses de iteración. Planteó un modelo agéntico para las operaciones de red, con agentes de IA a lo largo del ciclo de vida desde el aprovisionamiento hasta el retiro, prototipó su agente de NetBond, lideró el piloto empresarial de diseño con IA de AT&T y rediseñó los diagnósticos del portal DNI, lo que redujo el gasto en hardware en más de 300.000 dólares.

 Reconocido con el AT&T Connection Award cuatro años seguidos, de 2023 a 2026: Deep Network Integration Leadership, Setting User Experience Vision, NetBond Advanced Leadership y AI Design Leadership.

 Preguntas frecuentes

 ¿Quién es Micah Boswell?

 Micah Boswell es líder de diseño de producto en Dallas, Texas, con treinta años en software empresarial. Es Lead Product Designer en AT&T, donde prototipa agentes de IA para las operaciones de red. También escribe, es mentor de diseñadores y fotografía la ciudad.

 ¿Qué hace Micah Boswell en AT&T?

 Dirige el diseño de producto de las herramientas de infraestructura de red. Lideró el diseño de NetBond Advanced, ya disponible, con un prototipo en código que ingeniería usó como referencia visual. Planteó un modelo agéntico para las operaciones de red, con agentes de IA a lo largo del ciclo de vida desde el aprovisionamiento hasta el retiro, prototipó su agente de NetBond, lideró el piloto empresarial de diseño con IA de la compañía y rediseñó los diagnósticos del portal DNI, lo que ahorró más de 300.000 dólares en hardware.

 ¿De dónde es Micah Boswell?

 Creció en Lima, Perú, y habla español e inglés. Estudió en Hardin-Simmons University, en Abilene, Texas, y trabaja en Dallas desde finales de los años noventa.

 ¿Qué ha escrito Micah Boswell?

 Ensayos sobre diseño e IA en conscious-shell.com y en LinkedIn y más de cien respuestas en Quora.

 ¿Es el mismo Micah Boswell que encontré en otro sitio?

 Varias personas comparten el nombre. Esta página es sobre el diseñador de producto de Dallas que trabaja en AT&T. Sus perfiles están en la sección En otros sitios. Un perfil que no esté en esa lista es de otra persona.

 ¿Cómo contacto a Micah Boswell?

 Por el formulario de contacto de conscious-shell.com o por mensaje en LinkedIn.


## https://micahboswell.design/now

micahboswell.design · now

 Now

 What Micah Boswell is working on. A now page, in the tradition of nownownow.com: updated when things change, not on a schedule.

 At work

 October 2026
 Lead Product Designer at AT&T, on the tools that run on-premise and cloud network infrastructure. NetBond Advanced, whose design he led, is now live; engineering used his coded prototype as the visual reference for what to build. The current work is an agentic model for network operations, prototypes of AI agents across the lifecycle from provisioning through decommissioning, and the enterprise pilot that brought AI tools into the design organization. The design question he keeps coming back to: what a person is asked to accept at the moment the machine has just acted, and what the second question is after the first wrong answer.

 On the side

 Four small sites, each built because making something is how he learns a subject. None of them is a business.

 Pen Paper & Ink a fountain-pen almanac: every specimen measured by hand, dry times, pairings, and an MCP server so assistants can read the data directly

 GPSail a SailGP companion: Season 6 standings, schedule, and F50 explainers, in English and Arabic

 Family Roots Center a genealogy tool: GEDCOM import, ten visualizations, living-person redaction

 conscious_shell the portfolio, online since 2000, where the case studies and essays live

 Writing

 Essays on designing for AI and on search in the age of answer engines, listed under Writing. The most recent: Is AI replacing SEO?

 Mentoring

 One-on-one with designers moving into senior roles, through Designlab and ADPList. Forty-seven so far. How to book.

 Where

 Dallas, Texas. Downtown. Photographing it at night when the streets are wet, for Unsplash, where the photographs have passed 53.4 million views. The photography page.


## https://micahboswell.design/writing

micahboswell.design · writing

 Writing

 Everything Micah Boswell has published under his own name, in one place: essays on his portfolio site, articles on LinkedIn since 2016, and answers on Quora since 2011.

 Essays at conscious-shell.com

 What does a UX designer actually do on an AI product?2026-09-12The designer decides what happens at the moment a person is asked to accept what the machine just did. Where the source shows. What a wrong answer costs. Whether there is an undo. The second question, after the first wrong answer, is the whole job.

 Is AI replacing SEO?2026-09-15No. Three days of edge logs across four sites: 977 AI agents, 853 search crawlers, and every one of them arrived through robots.txt and sitemap.xml. What AEO actually changes, what llms.txt is worth, and what happened when three sites became MCP servers.

 The Diploma in the Drawer2026-08-28He finished his last class at Hardin-Simmons in 1992 and walked the stage in December 2025. Thirty-three years, most of them his own pride.

 Articles on LinkedIn

 Published on LinkedIn between 2016 and 2026. The method pieces came out of a weekly series he wrote for working designers.

 Also on LinkedIn, listed on his articles page:

 Are we building faster horses with AI?

 More Human Than Human

 Color Audit: the app a career built

 Smackintosh and Synner

 Answers on Quora

 Since January 2011: more than 120 answers and 400,000 content views on his Quora profile. The topics he answers most are user experience design, user interfaces, music, New Wave, and Dallas. He runs two Quora Spaces: eCommerce UX and Media Anthropology.


## https://micahboswell.design/mentoring

micahboswell.design · mentoring

 Mentoring

 Micah Boswell mentors product and UX designers one-on-one. Forty-seven so far.

 What a session is

 An hour on a real problem. A portfolio that is not landing. A case study that reads like a process diagram. A stakeholder who will not budge. A flow that tests badly and nobody can say why. The move from senior designer to design lead. Designing for an AI product when the model, not the screen, is the thing being designed.

 He works from what the designer brings, not from a syllabus. Thirty years of enterprise software at AT&T, Citi, GE, Dell and the U.S. Mint, and the current job, Lead Product Designer at AT&T, prototyping AI agents for network operations. English or Spanish. Remote, by video, from Dallas.

 Where to book

 ADPList open to anyone; book a one-on-one from the profile

 Designlab for Designlab students, across the Career Services and UI Design tracks

 CareerFoundry mentor and Instructor Advisory Board, 2020 to 2025; more than twenty emerging UX and UI designers, and a seat on the board that shaped curriculum and platform features

 The record

 Forty-seven designers mentored Designlab, ADPList and CareerFoundry, 2020 to now

 Instructor Advisory Board, CareerFoundry 2020 to 2025


 Questions people ask

 Does Micah Boswell mentor designers?

 Yes. Micah Boswell mentors product and UX designers one-on-one through Designlab and ADPList. He has mentored forty-seven designers so far and spent 2020 to 2025 as a mentor and Instructor Advisory Board member at CareerFoundry.

 How do I book a mentoring session with Micah Boswell?

 Book through his ADPList profile at adplist.org/mentors/micah-boswell, or through Designlab at app.designlab.com/micahboswell if you are a Designlab student. Sessions are one-on-one and by video.

 What does Micah Boswell mentor on?

 Portfolios that are not landing, case studies, stakeholders who will not budge, flows that test badly, design systems, moving from senior designer to design lead, and designing for AI products. He works from real problems the designer brings, not a syllabus.

 What is Micah Boswell's background as a mentor?

 Thirty years of enterprise software design for AT&T, Citi, GE, Dell, the U.S. Mint and others. Lead Product Designer at AT&T since 2021. At CareerFoundry he mentored more than twenty emerging UX and UI designers and sat on the Instructor Advisory Board that shaped curriculum and platform features.

 Where is Micah Boswell based, and does he mentor remotely?

 Dallas, Texas, Central time. All mentoring is remote by video, in English or Spanish.

 Use

 Everything on the Unsplash profile is under the Unsplash License: free for commercial and noncommercial use, no permission needed. Credit as "Micah Boswell on Unsplash" is appreciated. For prints, licensing outside Unsplash, or a commission, write to him.

 Questions people ask

 Does Micah Boswell have photographs on Unsplash?

 Yes. Micah Boswell has published 104 photographs on Unsplash as @micahboswell since November 2018. Together they have been viewed 53.4 million times and downloaded more than 362,000 times. Unsplash ranks him in the top 10 percent of its contributors.

 What does Micah Boswell photograph?

 Dallas at night, mostly: neon signs, wet streets, the Texas Theatre, bridges over the Trinity, holiday lights blurred through a windshield. Also doors and walls in Peru and Cuba, and the occasional Lego man.

 Can I use Micah Boswell's photographs?

 Yes. Everything on his Unsplash profile is under the Unsplash License, which allows free use for commercial and noncommercial purposes without permission. Credit to Micah Boswell is appreciated but not required.

 Which is Micah Boswell's most viewed photograph?

 A blue and black wooden board, shot in November 2018, with more than 36 million views and 228,000 downloads on Unsplash.

 What camera does Micah Boswell shoot with?

 Most of the Unsplash work is an iPhone. The short films of Dallas on Vimeo were shot on a Blackmagic Pocket Cinema Camera.
